subject: Night Passage Starless Gate environment
review: Inspected clay/material assembly from both sides, column front/side/rear, beacon close-up and all four production layouts with matched fallback, narrow and live UI.
Saved repairs narrowed the sill to avoid piercing tapered piers and separated coplanar corner coping. An intermediate added-corner repair did not solve the overlap and was removed.
Open arch and pale slotted columns distinguish the region; the floor stays quiet under void seals. Small slots and beacon details recede at narrow size.
Crystals are opaque emissive surfaces, not glass; no dynamic lights or animated sky. Art self-review does not establish independent or user approval.
